findings.title: Every template email carries a third link (the sender's website in the signature)
findings.why: templates.js promises "one link to the company's page and one to unsubscribe", and the AI prompt says the page link is "the only link", yet the signature it must copy word for word holds https://solutionai.in. qc.js deliberately allows it. Harmless in itself, but the promise, the prompt and the code disagree; decide which is meant.

findings.title: Transliteration variants of the same name are not even put in front of a reviewer
failing: translit.devanagari: not linked (no company with a similar name in the CIN universe we hold)
findings.why: Laxmi/Lakshmi, Shri/Shree, a name typed in Devanagari: the founder's company is in the universe but no candidate reaches the review queue, so the startup stays unlinked and its facts never join the company record. Precision is unharmed; recall on Hindi-belt names is.
